name: Belarus (1995–2012)
description: Two horizontal stripes of red and green in the ratio 2:1, with a vertical white stripe at the hoist bearing a narrow red Belarusian ornamental pattern.
history: Introduced by presidential decree No. 214 of 7 June 1995 after the disputed May 1995 referendum restored a Soviet-style flag in place of the white-red-white. In this original version the red ornament occupied only one twelfth of the flag's width on a wider white margin; the 2012 standard of the State Committee for Standardisation widened the pattern to fill the whole ninth of the width, giving the current design.
